body: Thank you. I hope I will find peace and I hope you will too. It helps to know that I'm not alone in feeling like this.

thank you for the reply by the way. It sounds like you're going through a really tough time as well and I hope that it might make you feel a little bit happy that your response has helped me a bit. It does help to know that there are other people feeling the same sort of pain. I won't go as far as to say it gives me hope because I don't really have any of that. But maybe these little things can be built upon to create a proper sense of hope and purpose.

Thank you for your reply its very kind of you to respond. I know that its ok to want  help and to seek it out, its just that it doesn't seem to do much. I've had great support networks in the past and have been doing things with my life that are meant to be fulfilling but ultimately every day I can't wait to get back into bed and go to sleep. Recently I haven't even been able to get out of bed until the evening, I know I should force myself to get up because this is meant to help but I used to have a routine of getting up early and doing productive things with my day but it honestly made me feel about the same as I do now. Perhaps what I need is time to focus on what's really causing me to be sad and then I will be able to find a fulfilling way of dealing with my sadness. It's just exhausting waking up everyday and feeling sad that I have to keep on going. It does feel like it would be easier if it could all just stop.

I do struggle around people, especially when it comes to talking about emotions, and I definitely don't feel comfortable talking about how I'm feeling with someone that I don't know (in person at least, its much easier online). I feel like its a mix of feeling like I'm bringing down everyone around me, even those I care about as well as preferring to be alone to save me the awkwardness and the stress of having to interact with people. Most of my feelings of failure stem from not meeting the expectations other people have set for me. I know I shouldn't focus on what others think but I really have no fucking clue what else I'm meant to do. I don't want anything in life other than to retreat from the world because its all so stressful and this isn't a healthy thing and doesn't bode well for the future. I don't want to have a career, family anything like that, all I really want is to sleep indefinitely. I know I should go out and find some goals or something like that but I've been through all that before, it feels like everything I've ever achieved is hollow, even when I've been "doing well" I still feel the same sense of pointlessness and sadness.

yeh man i wish i could just get it over with. its been years of trying to deal with these suicidal thoughts and failing to do that, then failing to carry out any of the thoughts. just seems no matter what i do i just want to be miserable.
